description: This file contains unit tests for the GatewayAgentChannel component, verifying its delivery logic, initialization fallback, and case normalization behaviors.

classes.name: GatewayAgentChannelTests
classes.description: A suite of unit tests for validating the behavior of GatewayAgentChannel channels in various scenarios.

methods.name: should deliver blocks web chat
methods.description: Tests whether the webchat channel correctly determines deliverability based on the boolean input.

methods.name: should deliver allows last and provider channels
methods.description: Checks deliverability for several channels including last, whatsapp, telegram, googlechat, bluebubbles based on true/false flags.

methods.name: init raw normalizes and falls back to last
methods.description: Verifies that the initialization from raw string correctly normalizes input and defaults to 'last' for nil, empty, or unknown strings.
